name: Sorin 990 Pro 1 TB
analog: Samsung 990 PRO 1TB (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe drive with a nickel-coated controller, up to 7450 MB/s.
doc_notes: 1 TB M.2 2280 NVMe SSD, PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe.
Install in an M.2 slot with an M key; 2280 = 22 mm wide, 80 mm long.
Insert the gold fingers at about 20 degrees, press the drive flat, and fix it with the board's M.2 (PH0) screw at the notch.
Up to 7450 MB/s read and 6900 MB/s write in a PCIe 4.0 x4 slot; slower slots work at their own speed.
Endurance: 600 TBW. Limited 5-year warranty.
Do not remove the label: it spreads heat and voids the warranty if removed.
Use the motherboard's M.2 heatsink if it has one; peel its pad film first.
Newly installed drives must be initialised (GPT) and formatted before they show up.
